faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Assistant position at the Assam Institute of Management is September 7, 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree or be a Research Scholar in disciplines such as Economics, Statistics, Education, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or allied fields to be eligible for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Assistant post is 30 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules, so refer to the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Research Assistant role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 18,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications for the Research Assistant post must be submitted online through the official website of the Assam Institute of Management or via the direct application link provided in the important links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for the Research Assistant position at the Assam Institute of Management.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position at the Assam Institute of Management will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at the Assam Institute of Management is a contractual job. Details regarding the contract period will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the Research Assistant recruitment can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Research Assistant recruitment at the Assam Institute of Management is AIM/01/22/2010/8044.
